neighbours.label: the geometry of a body's position or motion in space: angle, azimuth, maneuvers, motion over time
fire: Reaching the poles required the probe to perform maneuvers.
Azimuth is the angle of the star from north.
It is hard to get the exact position of the comet, and its motion.
Elevation is the angle between the horizon and the star.
Reaching orbit required the rocket to perform burns.
Its motion across the sky is slow.
The angle between the Sun and the Moon changes.
Getting there required the craft to swing past Venus.
quiet: Reaching the office required the staff to take trains.
Height is the size of the wall from the floor.
It is hard to get the exact price of the car, and its age.
Rent is the money between the owner and the tenant.
Reaching town required the family to take buses.
Its paint across the door is old.
The fence between the yard and the road changes.
Getting there required the crew to drive past Reno.

short: position and motion in the sky
notes: Probes: 0.34-0.57 against near misses up to 0.26. The + pole fires on instruments (weather instruments, warheads).
